note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the rule text is supplied by the author, no rule is applied and no outcome, winner or score is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Four fictional facts; the written warning is recorded only in the earlier case. Board A: the new case leaves that cell empty, the link breaks and the magnifier lifts the warning into the rule's clip. Board B: the new case records the same warning, every column links and the clip stays empty.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a five-fact tenancy example in which the distinguishing fact (a phoned complaint) is recorded only in the NEW case, so on board A the empty cell is in the earlier strip and the token is lifted from the new strip; on board B both cases record the complaint.

rules: Rule Q (illustrative), as stated by the author for the earlier case

scenarioA.label: Distinguishing fact present
scenarioA.caption: Only the new case records the complaint

params.changedFact: Only change: whether the earlier case also records the complaint

comparisonLabels.neutral: Two supplied variants side by side — nothing is decided

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long scenario labels and captions, long fact texts in the legend, a long rule, changed-fact line, guide label and neutral note to exercise wrapping and bounded shrinking.

facts.text: The buyer signed the standard order form at the counter of the shop
The goods were delivered to the buyer's warehouse on the third day
The seller sent a written warning about late payment before delivery
The full price was paid in cash to the seller's representative

rules: Rule R (illustrative text supplied by the author), as formulated in the earlier fictional case on its own facts
issues: Does the written warning make a difference for rule R in the new situation, or not?
assumptions: All facts are fictional; every other fact of the two situations is treated as equal

scenarioA.label: Situation A — the distinguishing fact is present
scenarioA.caption: The new situation does not record the written warning that the earlier case records

scenarioB.label: Situation B — the distinguishing fact is absent
scenarioB.caption: The new situation records exactly the same written warning as the earlier case

params.changedFact: The only change between the two boards: whether the new situation also records the written warning about late payment
sharedFacts: Same facts in the same order

comparisonLabels.guide: Changed fact: the written warning in the new situation
comparisonLabels.neutral: Two variants of one fictional example shown side by side — no outcome, winner or score is shown

presets.name: baseline-es
presets.description: Baseline in Spanish (built-in labels and fictional content).

facts.text: El vendedor envió un aviso por escrito

rules: Regla R (ilustrativa), tal como se formuló en el caso anterior
issues: ¿Importa el aviso para la regla R?
assumptions: Hechos ficticios; todo lo demás se mantiene igual

scenarioA.label: Hecho diferenciador presente
scenarioA.caption: El caso nuevo no recoge el aviso

scenarioB.label: Hecho diferenciador ausente
scenarioB.caption: El caso nuevo recoge el mismo aviso

params.changedFact: Único cambio: si el caso nuevo recoge el aviso por escrito

comparisonLabels.neutral: Dos variantes de un ejemplo ficticio — no se muestra ningún resultado
